summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, together with XBRL tagging detail; no transactional event is disclosed. Nothing in the excerpt sets a price per share, stake percentage, premium, or closing date, and no board recommendation or financial advisor is named. The only discrete items are equity grants to the Chief Knowledge Officer and certain directors in June 2026, plus references to warrant measurement inputs and a possible bid-price compliance threshold, which are disclosure mechanics rather than a corporate action. No special-situation angle is present; watch only for future disclosure on Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance.
